rss: 'My parents won't lend me £10k but helped my brother': When families play financial favourites
title: Kids Choose Fair Sharing with Money
story: Imagine if your parents gave your sibling more candy than you. How would you feel? It's important to make sure everyone is treated fairly when sharing.
storyBig: In families, sometimes money isn't shared equally, leading to feelings of unfairness. It's crucial to discuss and ensure that financial decisions are made fairly to avoid future conflicts.
think: How can families make sharing fair for everyone?

rss: I was spending £700 a month: How I beat my late-night shopping addiction
title: Smart Shopping: Avoid Impulse Buys
story: Have you ever bought something and later thought, 'Oops, I didn't really need that?' Being a smart shopper means thinking before you buy.
storyBig: Impulse shopping can lead to spending more money than planned. By practicing mindful shopping, we can make better financial decisions and avoid unnecessary expenses.
think: What helps you decide if you really need something?
bull: Smart shopping saves money for fun things later.
bear: Buying without thinking can empty your piggy bank.
